Põe o ponteiro em escala completa, para: Puts the needle at full scale, for adjustment.

Pede confirmação: “Apagar definições e e: Asks for confirmation: “Erase settings and presets?”

Predefinição usa a velocidade fixa da co: Default uses the fixed speed of the build.
Stops at the ends, without wrapping around.
Gira a imagem da tela. A compilação para: Rotates the screen image. The DP-66X build already comes rotated.
Teclado numérico na tela, para digitar a: On-screen numeric keypad, to enter the frequency.
Calibra o toque. Só aparece no modelo To: Calibrates touch. Only appears on the Portable touch model.
Fica desligado quando há um conversor co: Stays off when a converter is set up.
Mostra o RadioText completo, em vez de l: Shows the full RadioText, instead of letter by letter.

Mostra o nome longo da emissora (Long PS: Shows the station’s long name (Long PS), when it broadcasts one.
Limite inferior da faixa de FM. Em 76,1: Lower limit of the FM band. At 76.1 MHz, the band covers extended FM.
Girando para um lado, sobe 0,1 MHz; para: Turning one way goes up 0.1 MHz; the other way goes down 1 MHz. To go from 87.5 to 76.1 MHz, go down 12 times, to 75.5, and up 6.
Upper limit of the FM band.
Girando para um lado, sobe 0,1 MHz; para: Turning one way goes up 0.1 MHz; the other way goes down 1 MHz.
Abaixo desse nível, o rádio trata o sina: Below this level, the radio treats the signal as weak and grays out RDS and the modulation meter.
Passo do encoder no FM. O código soma o: Encoder step on FM. The code adds the step starting from the band edge, so the edge decides which decimals tuning stops on.
Compensa perda ou ganho de sinal antes d: Compensates for signal loss or gain before the radio, on AM.
Mostra a faixa de ondas curtas em metros: Shows the shortwave band in meters, such as 49 m, next to the frequency.
Sensibilidade do detector de co-canal, q: Sensitivity of the co-channel detector, which warns when two stations share the same frequency.
Contagem que o detector de co-canal prec: Count the co-channel detector must reach before it warns.
Último número do IP do computador que ro: Last number of the IP address of the computer running StationList.
Apaga a tela enquanto o XDRGTK está cone: Turns the screen off while XDRGTK is connected.
Ao ligar, o rádio trava no PI da estação: When turned on, the radio locks onto the PI of the tuned station and shows the code next to it. Without RDS, it shows “Error! No RDS signal”.
Fora do menu, aperte MODE até aparecer M: Outside the menu, press MODE until MEM appears, then BAND. While scanning, MEM blinks.
Primeira memória do intervalo. Só entram: First memory channel of the range. Only FM and OIRT channels are included.
Always lower than the end channel.
Last memory channel of the range.
Always higher than the start channel.
Quanto tempo o rádio fica em cada frequê: How long the radio stays on each frequency before moving on.
Começa em 0,5 s; depois vai de 1 a 30 s,: Starts at 0.5 s; then goes from 1 to 30 s, in steps of 1.
Em Apenas, passa só pelas memórias do in: With Only, it goes through the channels of the range only. With Exclude, it scans the band and skips the frequencies saved in the range.
Desligado nunca para. PI correto para ao: Off never stops. Correct PI stops when it decodes a PI. Signal stops when it finds a signal, using the threshold from FM settings → Scan sensitivity.
Grava sozinho no logbook as estações com: Automatically saves to the logbook the stations with a correct PI found during the scan.
Usa o tempo de espera só nas frequências: Uses the wait time only on frequencies with a signal.
Exporte o logbook antes, se quiser guard: Export the logbook first if you want to keep it.
Preenche as memórias numa faixa de frequ: Fills the memory channels across a frequency range and a range of positions.
Searches for stations and saves them to the memory channels.
Evita gravar a mesma emissora duas vezes: Avoids saving the same station twice: Range compares with the channels of the range; Full, with all of them.
É o mesmo ajuste de Configurações FM → S: It is the same setting as FM settings → Scan sensitivity.
Make a backup first if you want to keep them.
Créditos dos desenvolvedores e colaborad: Credits for the developers and contributors.
Simple mode hides the advanced options. DEEPELEC recommends turning on Advanced mode through the Chinese menu: Language → 简体中文, then 主要设置 → 系统使用模式 → 高级模式, and back to English.
Quais faixas de FM o BAND percorre. FML: Which FM bands BAND cycles through. FML is the low band chosen in Set FML band.
Combinações de FM e FML, ou None. O text: Combinations of FM and FML, or None. The manual’s text is cut off; the likely order is FM + FML, FML, FM, None.
Combinações de LW, MW, SW e AIR, ou NONE: Combinations of LW, MW, SW and AIR, or NONE. The manual’s text is cut off.
Junto do tempo, escolha a ação: tela apa: Together with the time, choose the action: screen off or 1%, 25% or 50% brightness.
Screen shown when the radio turns on.
O firmware também tem Main page + Keypad: The firmware also has Main page + Keypad. With Open menu, Select menu group appears.
O que acontece ao segurar o BAND por 3 s: What happens when you hold BAND for 3 s.
O manual cita só Power off; as outras du: The manual only mentions Power off; the other two come from the firmware.
Deixa a tela estática depois do tempo de: Freezes the screen after the Still screen timer time.
Idle time before the screen freezes.
To turn it back on, press BW.
Turns the radio off in software.
MPX manda o áudio mono no canal esquerdo: MPX sends mono audio on the left channel and the full MPX signal on the right, to analyze RDS and stereo.
A partir de que frequência os agudos são: Frequency above which treble is cut when the signal drops below the threshold.
Abaixo desse nível de sinal, o corte de: Below this signal level, the treble cut kicks in.
On usa o botão SQL. Auto controla o sque: On uses the SQL knob. Auto controls the squelch on its own and may hide distant signals.
Curva de desênfase do áudio de FM. O Bra: FM audio deemphasis curve. Brazil uses 50 µs.
Beep when going past the end of the band.
Bipe a cada operação. Não está no manual: Beep on every operation. Not in the manual.
O Megatron só tem inglês e chinês simpli: Megatron only has English and Simplified Chinese.
Aurora, Ember e Glacier só existem no có: Aurora, Ember and Glacier only exist in the v2.20.12 code; DEEPELEC's v2.20.8 package has the other 14. In the v2.11.x packages, Queer is called Maroon, with the same colors, and Bubblegum only appears from v2.11.5 on. Whiteout is the only light theme.
Essas fontes só têm os algarismos e o po: These fonts only have the digits and the decimal point. Comic was removed from the code in December 2025 to free up flash space; DEEPELEC's packages up to v2.20 still include it.
Chinese Red e Retro só existem no Megatr: Chinese Red and Retro only exist in the Megatron. Retro arrived in Mod17; Mod16 has 14 themes. Bubblegum, Aurora, Ember and Glacier, which came later in the official line, are missing. Automatic switching between favorites is in My settings › My theme.
As mesmas da linha oficial até a v2.20,: The same as the official line up to v2.20, including Comic.
Intervalo de atualização do medidor. Mai: Meter refresh interval. Slower means less screen noise.
Estilo do medidor de sinal. O manual cha: Signal meter style. The manual calls it Color bar display mode.
Onde a interface usa cantos arredondados: Where the interface uses rounded corners.
Cores do relógio, das informações de dep: Colors of the clock, of the debug info and of the frequency name.
Mostra rótulos junto da frequência, como: Shows labels next to the frequency, such as RDX, WEK, MED, STR and SPR. The function was inferred from the firmware strings.
Frame around the startup screen logo.
Retângulo, tambor, elipse, círculo, hexá: Rectangle, drum, ellipse, circle, hexagon, parallelogram, rhombus or heart
Boa parte destas opções só aparece no mo: Many of these options only appear in advanced mode.
A vista RDS avançada do código-base most: The base code’s advanced RDS view shows PI, ECC, LIC, PIN, DI flags, AF, EON, RT+, ODA applications and errors per block.
Limite de erros aceito na decodificação: Error limit accepted when decoding RDS.
Troca os espaços por sublinhado no PS e: Replaces spaces with underscores in PS and RT.
PS only comes from the firmware.
Mostra os erros no código PI quando o si: Shows errors in the PI code when the signal is weak.
Sorts the AF list by frequency.
Inclui Initial; os outros valores não fo: Includes Initial; the other values have not been confirmed
Desliga toda a decodificação de RDS. Ent: Turns off all RDS decoding. Added in Mod16.
Só para quem usa conversor de RF externo: Only for those using an external RF converter.
Compensa perda ou ganho de sinal antes d: Compensates for signal loss or gain before the radio.
No código-base, abaixo desse nível o rád: In the base code, below this level the radio grays out RDS and the modulation meter.
Lowers the volume when it detects hiss.
The 76 to 87 MHz band was added in Mod16.
Mostra a faixa de ondas curtas em metros: Shows the shortwave band in meters, such as 49 m.
Sensibilidade do detector de co-canal, q: Sensitivity of the co-channel detector, which warns when two stations share the same frequency. 100% is the base code’s default.
Contagem que o detector precisa atingir: Count the detector must reach before it warns. 3 is the base code’s default.
Atenuador da entrada de AM, para sinais: AM input attenuator, for signals that are too strong.
Limiar do controle automático de ganho n: Threshold of the automatic gain control on AM.
A faixa aérea só funciona com um convers: The air band only works with an external converter sold separately.
Frequência do oscilador do conversor ext: Frequency of the external converter’s oscillator, in MHz.
Also depends on the external converter.
Start of the AIR band, in MHz.
Modo da porta USB, já com a velocidade d: USB port mode, already set to each program’s speed.
Connects the radio to a network.
Até 3 redes, só de 2,4 GHz: pelo teclado: Up to 3 networks, 2.4 GHz only: with the on-screen keypad (SSID and password), with a browser (portal at 192.168.4.1) or Delete Wi-Fi.
Senha para o XDRGTK controlar o rádio pe: Password for XDRGTK to control the radio over the network.
Computador que recebe a lista de estaçõe: Computer that receives the station list (StationList).
Apaga a tela enquanto o XDR-GTK está con: Turns the screen off while XDR-GTK is connected.
Desliga o Wi-Fi depois do tempo escolhid: Turns Wi-Fi off after the chosen time. With After time sync, it turns off right after setting the clock, which saves battery and keeps the battery reading working.
De 1 a 1440 min, ou After time sync: From 1 to 1440 min, or After time sync
Config slave host: controle de outro apa: Config slave host: control of another device, without audio.
Como o firmware lê o toque: por interrup: How the firmware reads touch: by interrupt (Int33 or Int27) or by polling (Polling). Off disables touch.
O knob de sintonia passa a ajustar o lim: The tuning knob now adjusts the squelch threshold.
Acelera a sintonia quando o knob gira rá: Speeds up tuning when the knob turns fast.
Troca mais rápida entre os grupos do men: Faster switching between the menu groups.
O que o toque longo nesta tecla faz. Cad: What a long press on this key does. Each key starts the list at a different point of the cycle.
O firmware também tem Frequency list e B: The firmware also has Frequency list and Band keypad.
The firmware also has Frequency list and Band keypad. The English manual repeats “Long press Rotary key” in place of this one.
Grava as mudanças sozinho. Em Off, o rád: Saves changes on its own. With Off, the radio asks Save or Discard when you exit.
Sets the clock by hand. Added in Mod16.
Date, time and date + time mode.
Fuso aplicado à hora do NTP. O horário d: Time zone applied to the NTP time. Brasília time is GMT−03:00.
Acerta a hora pela internet. Desde o Mod: Sets the time over the internet. Since Mod16, every 30 min.
Sets the time from the station’s RDS (CT). Some stations send the wrong time.
Corrige o atraso ou o adianto do relógio: Corrects the clock running slow or fast.
Turns the radio on at a set time.
Turns the radio off when the battery is low.
Versão, data de compilação, RAM, armazen: Version, build date, RAM, storage, tuner, NTP, IP and MAC.
Até 4 temas favoritos, trocados em sequê: Up to 4 favorite themes, switched in sequence or at random.
Saves or erases the personal set.
Como a busca grava: sobrescreve as memór: How the search saves: overwrites the memory channels or appends after the existing ones.
Continuously append comes from the firmware.
FM, LW, MW, SW, AIR e outras; a lista do: FM, LW, MW, SW, AIR and others; the manual’s list goes on

First memory channel the search uses.
